hook.en: You type the marks of 60 students into a program, close it, and everything is gone. Files keep data on the disk so the program can use it again tomorrow.
hook.kn: 60 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಅಂಕಗಳನ್ನು ನಮೂದಿಸಿ ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಂ ಮುಚ್ಚಿದರೆ ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಕಳೆದುಹೋಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಡತಗಳು ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಡಿಸ್ಕ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: Distinguish text files and binary files

narration.en: You type the marks of 60 students into a program, close it, and everything is gone. Files keep data on the disk so the program can use it again tomorrow.
narration.kn: 60 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಅಂಕಗಳನ್ನು ನಮೂದಿಸಿ ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಂ ಮುಚ್ಚಿದರೆ ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಕಳೆದುಹೋಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಡತಗಳು ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಡಿಸ್ಕ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Variables live in main memory (RAM) and are lost when the program ends. A file is a named location on secondary storage that stores data permanently. Python programs themselves are stored in files with the .py extension. File handling lets a program store its input and output data and reuse it later.

points.en: Each file has a name and location (path)
Programs read input from and write output to files

narration.en: Variables live in main memory (RAM) and are lost when the program ends. A file is a named location on secondary storage that stores data permanently. Python programs themselves are stored in files with the .py extension. File handling lets a program store its input and output data and reuse it later.
narration.kn: ಚರಾಂಶಗಳು RAM ನಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತವೆ, ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಂ ಮುಗಿದಾಗ ಕಳೆದುಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಕಡತ ದ್ವಿತೀಯ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಶಾಶ್ವತವಾಗಿ ಉಳಿಸುವ ಹೆಸರಿಸಿದ ಸ್ಥಳ.

body.en: A text file is a sequence of characters: letters, digits and symbols stored as ASCII or Unicode codes. Each line ends with an end-of-line (EOL) character, newline \n by default, and the file can be opened in any text editor. A binary file stores bytes that do not represent characters, such as images, audio, video, compressed and executable files. Opening one in a text editor shows garbage, and a single wrong bit can corrupt it.

points.en: Both are stored on disk as 0s and 1s

narration.en: A text file is a sequence of characters: letters, digits and symbols stored as ASCII or Unicode codes. Each line ends with an end-of-line (EOL) character, newline \n by default, and the file can be opened in any text editor. A binary file stores bytes that do not represent characters, such as images, audio, video, compressed and executable files. Opening one in a text editor shows garbage, and a single wrong bit can corrupt it.
narration.kn: ಪಠ್ಯ ಕಡತ ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳ ಸರಣಿ; ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಾಲು EOL ಅಕ್ಷರ \n ನಿಂದ ಕೊನೆಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ದ್ವಿಮಾನ (ಬೈನರಿ) ಕಡತ ಬೈಟ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುತ್ತದೆ: ಚಿತ್ರ, ಧ್ವನಿ, ವಿಡಿಯೋ, exe. ಅದನ್ನು ಪಠ್ಯ ಸಂಪಾದಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಓದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

problem.en: Classify each file as text or binary: report.txt, marks.csv, prog.py, selfie.jpg, song.mp3, setup.exe

steps.en: report.txt, marks.csv and prog.py contain characters only, so they are text files.
selfie.jpg (image) and song.mp3 (audio) store encoded bytes: binary.

answer.en: Text: report.txt, marks.csv, prog.py. Binary: selfie.jpg, song.mp3, setup.exe.

narration.en: Six files from your own computer. Sort them into text and binary.
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

points.en: A file stores data permanently on secondary storage.
Text files are characters with \n at the end of each line.
points.kn: ಪಠ್ಯ ಕಡತ: ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳು, ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಾಲಿನ ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ \n.

points.en: Binary files store bytes such as images, audio and executables.
points.kn: ಬೈನರಿ ಕಡತ: ಚಿತ್ರ, ಧ್ವನಿ, exe ಮುಂತಾದ ಬೈಟ್‌ಗಳು.

homework.en: List five text files and five binary files on your computer with their extensions.

narration.en: Recap. A file stores data permanently on secondary storage. Text files are characters with \n at the end of each line. Binary files store bytes such as images, audio and executables.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಕಡತ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಶಾಶ್ವತವಾಗಿ ಉಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪಠ್ಯ ಕಡತ: ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳು, ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಾಲಿನ ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ \n. ಬೈನರಿ ಕಡತ: ಚಿತ್ರ, ಧ್ವನಿ, exe ಮುಂತಾದ ಬೈಟ್‌ಗಳು.
